connected with the Irish Ormondes, the Butler family of great wealth and
power that had settled in Ireland in the twelfth century. In 1835 William
Butler Yeats (18o6-62), Yeats's grandfather, married Jane Grace Corbet (1811-
76), daughter of William Corbet (1757-1824) and Grace Armstrong Corbet
( 1774-1864). Both the Corbets and especially the Armstrongs had a long
history of military service.
